overview: Roadie Roster is a store staffing app for opening a new location: it tracks positions, roadie sign-ups, orientation, crews, leaders, gift bags and now uniform ordering.
features: Position uniform defaults with shirt and hat type and quantity
Roadie shirt and hat sizes collected at kiosk sign-up and editable by managers
Size curve percentages used to project sizes for unfilled positions
Uniform order page with Hired, Projected and Order total columns and All/FOH/BOH filters
Excel download and letter-size print of the uniform order
Demo mode keeps demo and real uniform data separate
